commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset}"; git status --porcelain; echo "---base---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main
gh pr diff 1714 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1714/31980862369-1/diff.patch | head -5; echo "---rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
SNAP=$(git status --porcelain); echo "before-lines=$(printf '%s' "$SNAP" | grep -c . )"; printf '%s' "$SNAP" | grep -v '^?? .prflow/tmp/' || echo "(only .prflow/tmp untracked)"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh requesting-code-review >/tmp/ext_out.txt 2>/tmp/ext_err.txt; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---STDOUT BYTES---"; wc -c </tmp/ext_out.txt; echo "---STDOUT---"; cat /tmp/ext_out.txt; echo "---STDERR---"; cat /tmp/ext_err.txt

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
